parties: Castor Investments Limited | Spencer's Retail Limited
headline: Castor Investments Discloses Substantial Share Acquisition in Spencer's Retail under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Castor Investments Limited filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares in Spencer's Retail Limited. The filing triggers mandatory disclosure requirements under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
implication: Any acquisition crossing the 25% threshold (or 5% acquisition within a week by a single acquirer) mandates public disclosure; this filing confirms Castor has crossed a gating threshold and likely triggers an open offer obligation under Regulation 38 unless exempted.
detail: Castor Investments Limited submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to the National Stock Exchange, a mandatory form filed when a party acquires shares above prescribed thresholds. Spencer's Retail Limited is a retail subsidiary of RP-Sanjiv Goenka group. The disclosure initiates the takeover code compliance framework. Specific acquisition size, offer price, and timeline of the mandatory open offer (if applicable) are not disclosed in this filing document alone.
